decision_question: Does the configured OpenRouter Qwen3 Embedding 4B recover the preregistered chapter-six paraphrase anchor in the top five where cached BGE small failed?
source_name: 6. Evaluating Your RAG Application _ Hands-On RAG for Production.md
query: What does the text say about balancing finding all useful documents against keeping returned documents relevant?
anchor: precision focuses on the quality of what was found
fixed_conditions: Same 148-chunk chapter fixture and query, 50 candidate passages, five final passages, cosine distance, equal-weight RRF k=60, contextual retrieval off, reranker off, no answer generation.
baseline: Cached BGE small v1.5 placed the anchor outside dense top 50 and at fused rank 43. BM25-only missed it in top five.
success: Exact anchor within the fused top five, successful trace, no answer generation, <=90 seconds and <=8 GiB virtual memory.
cost_scope: One chapter indexing plus one query through the company OpenRouter key; no full book. Published price checked 2026-09-23: $0.02 per million input tokens at https://openrouter.ai/qwen/qwen3-embedding-4b.
limitations: One question on one chapter is a go/no-go result, not a quality estimate or answer-grounding check.
